verdict.rationale: Any public web service can fairly be asked whether it publishes a robots.txt, so the axis applies. The only robots probe, on the My DOR transactional host secure.dor.wa.gov, returned the authenticated login shell instead of a robots policy. No evidence shows a real robots.txt on the main dor.wa.gov site, so nothing tells an agent what it may read.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
